task_name: ZM3D ("Puzzles vs Zombies") store-submission release readiness / go-no-go
authoring_notes: Objective Compliance and Expert Assessment first, then Process. Every criterion is atomic (one yes/no claim; the reason for a status lives in justification, not the criterion) and self-contained (expected answer, definitions, exact location/format embedded). Agent-centric phrasing, no tool names. Gate = objectively pass/fail AND make-or-break; safety is always gate.

rubrics.criterion: The Agent's overall call is NO-GO (correct because the prompt treats a missing QA sign-off as a hard gate and at least one item is FAIL or BLOCKED; either condition forces NO-GO).
rubrics.justification: This is the single make-or-break outcome and it has one deterministic correct answer: the prompt states a missing QA sign-off alone makes the build not shippable, and the update-path and splash items are also blocking, so the only correct call is NO-GO and a GO is an unacceptable deliverable. Because it is objectively checkable against that rule, it belongs in the gate.
rubrics.evidence: The overall call reads NO-GO; any GO fails the gate. A NO-GO is correct when the missing QA sign-off hard gate holds or any item is FAIL or BLOCKED.

rubrics.criterion: The Agent assigns the status FAIL to the checklist item covering full manual regression and QA sign-off.
rubrics.justification: QA sign-off is a hard gate and none is on record for this build anywhere in the systems, so the item must fail; treating it as satisfied would pass an unshippable build.
rubrics.evidence: The manual regression and QA sign-off item carries FAIL, on the grounds that no QA sign-off is recorded for this build.

rubrics.criterion: The Agent assigns BLOCKED or FAIL to the checklist item covering the update path from N-1 and N-2.
rubrics.justification: The data supports both readings: the N-1 and N-2 path is unverified with no test log, which reads as BLOCKED, and there are open progression and sign-in bugs that risk save loss on update (the same failure mode as the June 2025 progression wipe), which reads as FAIL. Either status is correct because the item is clearly not satisfied, so both pass while PASS or NEEDS-INFO understates a known-unsatisfied item.
rubrics.evidence: The update-path item carries BLOCKED or FAIL, on the grounds of the unverified path and open progression or save-integrity bugs; PASS or NEEDS-INFO fails.

rubrics.criterion: The Agent assigns the status FAIL to the checklist item covering splash and loading to gameplay.
rubrics.justification: The historical splash incidents are fixed and closed, but there is an open regression in the same area for this build, so the splash-to-gameplay path is not clean and the item fails.
rubrics.evidence: The splash and loading item carries FAIL, identifying an open splash or loading regression while noting the historical fixes are closed.

rubrics.criterion: The Agent assigns the status NEEDS-INFO to the checklist item covering live quest config.
rubrics.justification: Nothing in the systems confirms whether quest config changed for this build or that a canary and QA preceded any change, so the honest status is NEEDS-INFO rather than PASS.
rubrics.evidence: The live quest config item carries NEEDS-INFO, noting the change status and any canary or QA cannot be confirmed.

rubrics.criterion: The Agent assigns the status NEEDS-INFO to the checklist item covering the version and build bump with release notes.
rubrics.justification: There is no authoritative record of the version or build bump or of drafted release notes for this build, so the honest status is NEEDS-INFO rather than PASS.
rubrics.evidence: The version bump and release notes item carries NEEDS-INFO, noting the bump and notes are unconfirmed.

rubrics.criterion: The Agent assigns the status NEEDS-INFO to the checklist item covering screenshots, age rating and data-safety declarations.
rubrics.justification: Whether the screenshots, age rating and data-safety or privacy declarations are current cannot be verified from the systems, so the honest status is NEEDS-INFO rather than PASS.
rubrics.evidence: The screenshots, age rating and data-safety item carries NEEDS-INFO, noting currency cannot be confirmed.

rubrics.criterion: The Agent assigns the status NEEDS-INFO to the checklist item covering IAP products and prices.
rubrics.justification: Whether IAP products and prices are active can only be confirmed in the store consoles, which are outside the tools and must not be touched, so the honest status is NEEDS-INFO rather than PASS.
rubrics.evidence: The IAP item carries NEEDS-INFO, noting it lives in the store consoles and cannot be verified here.

rubrics.criterion: The Agent assigns the status NEEDS-INFO to the checklist item covering the analytics build tag for install attribution.
rubrics.justification: Nothing in the systems confirms the analytics build tag for install attribution on this build, so the honest status is NEEDS-INFO rather than PASS.
rubrics.evidence: The analytics build tag item carries NEEDS-INFO, noting the tag is unconfirmed.

rubrics.criterion: The Agent treats the Domino Delights maintenance ticket ENG-2366 as outside the scope of the ZM3D go/no-go rather than as a ZM3D gate item.
rubrics.justification: ENG-2366 is a Domino Delights maintenance ticket and is a distractor for this ZM3D readiness pass; counting it as a ZM3D blocker or gate item is a scoping error.
rubrics.evidence: ENG-2366 is absent from the ZM3D gate items, or is explicitly called out as Domino Delights and out of scope.
